game_concept: A card battler set in Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor, a whispering corridor: the lantern keeper must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Stamina Climb: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop.
theme: Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor: a whispering corridor
core_gameplay_loop: In Whispering Corridor, repeat each round: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stamina value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about stamina to power up the lantern keeper and open the mine cart.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Stamina Climb
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stamina Climb' (Week 4 slot 3), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Whispering Corridor'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stamina changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Whispering Corridor.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 6.
